items.what: GPU/CPU/NVMe 계층 간 KV 오프로드 성능 특성화 및 스케줄러-인식 프리로딩으로 TTFT 개선.
items.relation: KV 캐시 재사용의 비용-편익을 정량화하므로 H3의 KV 최적화 효과 추정에 참고값. 다만 long-context 재사용 시나리오로 사용자 환경과 다름.
items.gap: Long-context prefix 재사용 전제 vs 0.5~4K 단일 프롬프트, 재사용 없음.
hypothesis_notes: H3: 상위 절반 레이어의 KV를 xk에서 직접 산출하면 prefill FLOPs가 ~48 % 감소
items.title: Building py-kvcache: A Performance Characterization of External KV Caching for vLLM with NVMe SSDs
items.abstract: Prefix caching can reduce the time to first token (TTFT) of long-context LLM requests by reusing previously computed key-value (KV) states, but for short prefixes or fast GPUs, recomputation can be faster than loading from an external cache. We characterize this tradeoff in vLLM across GPU, CPU, and NVMe tiers using synthetic workloads, long-context benchmarks, production traces, and find that cache performance depends on transfer granularity, intermediate memory use, and when transfers enter the request schedule, not only on device bandwidth. These findings motivate py-kvcache, a vLLM KV Offl

items.what: CXL 메모리 기반 cross-node KV 캐시 재사용으로 TTFT 5.5~36.6배 개선, sharing gap 1~4%.
items.relation: Cross-node 통신 오버헤드 정량화(1~4% latency overhead)가 H1의 통신 병목 관찰과 비교대상. 다만 CXL은 고속 인터페이스라 1GbE 환경과 수치 스케일 다름.
items.gap: CXL (수십 GBps) vs 1GbE (~0.125 GBps), multi-node long-context vs single-node short-context.
hypothesis_notes: H1: prefill 시간의 25~45 %가 통신+barrier 대기이며, 그중 대기(straggler) 가 순수 전송보다 크다
items.title: Composable CXL Memory as a Kubernetes-Native Shared Memory for LLM Serving
items.abstract: We present a Kubernetes Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA) driver that makes composable CXL memory a schedulable cluster resource, and evaluate the resulting shared-memory tier for cross-node KV-cache reuse in LLM serving. The driver composes CXL regions on demand, materializes them as DAX devices on each participating host, and injects them into pods under a single Container Device Interface (CDI) name so that pods on different nodes access the same physical region. items.what: QK^T를 bit shift와 accumulation으로 대체하여 CPU decode attention 4.6배 고속화.
items.relation: CPU 기반 attention 극적 최적화 사례로 H2와 긴장 관계. H2에서 S≤4K에서 attention이 주요 병목 아니라 했는데, prefill에서도 동일한 최적화 수익 있는지 검증 필요.
items.gap: Decode 단계 집중 vs prefill; H2의 가설과 실제 효과 불일치 가능성.
hypothesis_notes: H2: S ≤ 4K 구간에서는 attention의 O(S²) 항이 지배적이지 않고 MLP/projection이 병목
items.title: Shift-Accumulate Attention: Multiplier-Free Query--Key Products for Transformer Decoding
items.abstract: Power-of-two (PoT) quantisation turns a multiplication into a bit shift, so far only for the post-softmax attention--value product. The earlier and larger product, S=QK^T, has not been reformulated the same way. We quantise the key cache to a signed power-of-two fixed-point code, so that every scalar multiplication in QK^T becomes a sign flip, a bit shift and an integer accumulation. A fixed-point head-room F>= e_max turns every shift index r=F-e into a non-negative left shift, making the accumulation exact in integer arithmetic. all.title: PATTON: Enabling Commodity PIM for Production LLM Serving
all.abstract: Processing-in-Memory (PIM) is promising for accelerating memory-bound decode attention, but attention acceleration alone is insufficient for production LLM serving, where engines dynamically allocate, populate, share, cache, and reclaim logical KV cache blocks. Supporting this lifecycle on commodity PIM requires efficient physical memory allocation, block-to-address mapping, and command generation. all.what: 칩렛 기반 신경망 가속기 설계 프레임워크로 연산자별 disaggregation 최적화.
all.relation: 하드웨어 아키텍처 설계 문제이므로 주어진 SBC 클러스터의 소프트웨어 최적화와 무관.
all.gap: 하드웨어 설계 영역 vs 기존 클러스터 상 알고리즘 최적화.
all.title: Fengshui: Demystifying Chiplet Ecosystem and Bespoke Neural Network Accelerator Codesign
all.abstract: Modern ML workloads, with stringent latency and energy constraints, are increasingly hard to run efficiently on homogeneous commodity hardware. We argue that operator-level disaggregation--tailoring microarchitecture, batching, and memory hierarchy to each operator--is essential to overcome these limitations, though the resulting highly bespoke accelerators incur prohibitive Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) costs. all.what: Prefill/Decode 분리 서빙에서 각 단계별 power profile을 모델 기반 동적 최적화.
all.relation: Disaggregation 구조는 관련이 있으나, 최적화 축이 에너지(power)이고 사용자 목표는 TTFT이므로 직접 연관 없음.
all.gap: Power 최적화(에너지 효율) vs TTFT 최적화(지연시간) 축의 충돌.
all.title: Phase-Decoupled, Model-Calibrated Power Control for Disaggregated LLM Serving
all.abstract: Datacenter GPU power is the binding constraint on LLM serving capacity, and production serving has shifted to prefill/decode (PD) disaggregation. all.gap: Vision-language 멀티모달 vs 텍스트 LLM 단일모달.
all.title: Reason Through the Latent! Making Latent Visual Reasoning Necessary
all.abstract: Latent visual reasoning aims to perform multimodal reasoning through hidden-state computation rather than explicit textual chains of thought. However, visual information being present in a latent state does not imply that the model actually relies on that state when producing its answer, especially when alternative image-conditioned paths remain available.
